channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nikola Jovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nikola Jovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on being in Miami:

“Coach Spo brings the best out of players. I want to be coached hard…. I want people when they’re at work thinking about the Heat. I want people when they’re at their couch watching their favorite show to turn that off and put the Heat…I’m very excited to get in the gym with Bam, Mitchell, Wiggins, all these great players, Jovic.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic, Jul 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Kel'el Ware
item.description:
“And then, you know, we have some really talented young guys that he understands that Kel'el [Ware] and Niko [Jovic],”

Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Kel'el Ware, Jan 1, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Bam Adebayo, on not facing Nikola Jovic today:

“I think it would have been a great moment for me & Niko to play against each other. I'm definitely going to reach out to him, check up on him. I want him to get healthy because he's on the good side. Need him to get healthy for the season.”

Bam Adebayo on Nikola Jovic, Jul 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic getting ejected after picking up two techs:

“I'm definitely not gonna try to squash that. We love passion, competition, guys getting into all that.”

Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Mar 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jaime Jaquez, Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Jimmy Butler on Jaime Jaquez and Nikola Jovic stepping up with him out:

“I knew that would happen. They’re gonna help this organization for a long time after I’m gone.”

Jimmy Butler on Jaime Jaquez, Nikola Jovic, Jan 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic's knee injury:

“He did feel better today. We’re just going to get it checked out to do our due diligence. But we’ll see how he feels once we get the scans and everything.”

Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Oct 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Jimmy Butler on Nikola Jovic:

“He’s going to play a significant role in these games with us. This kid is walking around like he’s been here six or seven years.”

Jimmy Butler on Nikola Jovic, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Svetislav Pesic on Bogdan Bogdanovic, Nikola Jokic, Aleksej Pokusevski, Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Nikola Jokic and Nikola Jovic are still active in the playoffs with Denver Nuggets and Miami Heat, while Bogdan Bogdanovic and Aleksej Pokusevski finished the season.

“Pokusevski is back, he will train until the beginning of July, we are waiting to see what will be the situation with Jovic. We talked with Nikola Jokić. We’ll see how far he will go in the NBA playoffs,Nikola is happy in the national team, he wants to play, but we have to wait a bit. We are also waiting for Bogdanovic, who is recovering from a tough season,”

Svetislav Pesic on Bogdan Bogdanovic, Nikola Jokic, Aleksej Pokusevski, Nikola Jovic, May 8, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic:

“He wants to be good right away, which is a great trait to have. He's almost been apologetic after the last two.”

Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic, Jul 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Heat Summer League coach Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic:

“He's got a good feel for the game offensively, in terms that he doesn't force things... He can put it on the floor and attack, which is encouraging for a young guy.”

Malik Allen on Nikola Jovic, Jul 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.
